# Blitz API

BlitzAPI provides people, company, and job search plus contact and company enrichment for sales workflows.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/blitz-api/.

## Actions

- **Enrich Company** (read-only): Retrieve a full company profile from an exact LinkedIn company page URL.
- **Find Companies Hiring** (read-only): Find distinct companies hiring for matching jobs and return each company's matched-job count.
- **Find Work Email** (read-only): Retrieve a verified work email for a person identified by LinkedIn profile URL.
- **Get API Key Details** (read-only): Validate the connected BlitzAPI key and return its record balance, per-endpoint rate limit, allowed API routes, and active plans.
- **Get Changelog** (read-only): Return recent public BlitzAPI changelog entries newest first, optionally limited by age and count.
- **Get Company Employee Distribution** (read-only): Return a company's employee counts and percentages grouped by country or department.
- **List Company Employees** (read-only): Browse employees at one exact LinkedIn company using location, seniority, department, and connection-count filters.
- **Resolve Domain to LinkedIn Company** (read-only): Resolve a website domain or URL to its primary LinkedIn company page and possible alternatives.
- **Resolve LinkedIn Company to Domain** (read-only): Resolve a LinkedIn company page URL to its canonical email domain.
- **Resolve Person** (read-only): Resolve a verified work email or US phone number in E.164 format to a full professional profile.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Search companies by firmographics, funding, traffic, keywords, and headquarters criteria.
- **Search Company Jobs** (read-only): List live job postings for one exact LinkedIn company, optionally filtered by job attributes.
- **Search Jobs** (read-only): Search live job postings by role, description, semantic keywords, recency, location, and company criteria.
- **Search People** (read-only): Search professional profiles across one or more companies using person, role, location, education, and firmographic filters.
- **Waterfall ICP Search** (read-only): Find and rank decision-makers at one company using an ordered cascade of title and location rules.
